scripts.build: npm run quality && npm run build -w @amaral.codes/website
scripts.build:production: npm run content:sync -- all && npm run verify:publication && npm run build:production-content -w @amaral.codes/website
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: npm run build:production && npm run verify:cloudflare && wrangler deploy --config packages/website/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.quality:hygiene: eslint --max-warnings 0 scripts && node --test 'scripts/**/*.test.mjs' && node scripts/check-architecture.mjs && node scripts/commands/check-module-structure.mjs && node scripts/commands/check-repository-hygiene.mjs && node scripts/commands/check-content/index.mjs && node scripts/release-safety/index.mjs
scripts.quality: npm run quality:hygiene && npm run quality:publishing && npm run quality --workspaces
scripts.verify:release: npm run quality && npm run verify:assets -w @amaral.codes/website && npm run build -w @amaral.codes/website && npm run verify:cloudflare && npm run test:browser && npm run perf -- --assert --runs=3 && npm audit --audit-level=high
